name: poetree-platform
description: Poetree Publication — multi-tenant preschool learning & school management platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @poetree/shared && npm run build -w @poetree/api && npm run build -w @poetree/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @poetree/api" "npm run dev -w @poetree/web"
